entryOffer.name: First Promotion Starter
entryOffer.headline: Clarify the first marketing move before subscribing.
entryOffer.description: A one-time business context summary, promotion brief, hooks, copy variants, and CTA. No automatic subscription and no media production included.

plans.name: Core
plans.headline: Finish the next marketing move.
plans.description: Connect business context, a priority marketing question, a reviewable result, actual use, and the next question in one self-serve workflow.
publicHighlights: AI drafts, direct edits, and exact-version approval
Basic monthly AI and media allowance
plans.usageNote: Best for one owner building a repeatable marketing habit. Allowances are preview limits until cost and usage are validated.

plans.name: Plus
plans.headline: Improve the message through more iterations.
plans.description: Keep the same problem-to-result workflow while adding more AI variations, channel-ready versions, and media capacity.
publicHighlights: More AI drafts, variations, and re-analysis
Larger image, short-video, and history allowance
plans.usageNote: Best for testing more than one execution path without turning every variation into a new subscription.

plans.name: Pro
plans.headline: Run a higher-volume learning loop.
plans.description: Operate the full problem-to-result workflow across more messages and channels with the highest preview usage capacity.
publicHighlights: Highest AI and media usage capacity
Longer work, approval, and usage history
plans.usageNote: Best for owners who repeatedly create, review, use, and learn from multiple marketing executions.
